title: Dark Gradient Video Collaboration Landing Page

analysis.title: Dark Gradient Video Collaboration Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark, atmospheric landing page centers a large video card above an oversized gradient headline, with floating controls and a circular talking-head overlay adding depth. Soft glows, rounded surfaces, and a restrained neon palette balance polished SaaS clarity with playful art direction.
analysis.heroPrompt: A cinematic editorial video still of a sculptural miniature tree with a twisted trunk and sparse pink blossoms growing from a weathered stone block, isolated against a smooth blue-to-lavender sky gradient. Soft studio lighting, subtle atmospheric haze, refined 3D realism, centered composition, gentle shadows, and ample negative space around the subject. The image should feel like a premium creative collaboration product showcase, with no text, logos, interface elements, or recognizable people.
